share_notice: The report and your X link will be public only after your explicit consent and review. Account control and checksums do not verify the measurements.

measurement_quality.message: Unknown, limited or affected measurement conditions prevent submission.
measurement_quality.next_action: Keep the local report. Resolve interference and restore background monitoring, then recommend a new measurement. Obtain disk-write authorization before rerunning; do not edit quality fields to bypass checks.

generic.message: The community operation could not be completed.
generic.next_action: Use list to inspect local history, then choose the matching operation. Do not delete state or bypass consent.

arguments.next_action: Read the selected subcommand --help; use full option names once each.

input.message: The selected report or public fields are not valid.
input.next_action: Check the named fields against the preserved original result. Do not invent missing measurements, remove the integrity notice or start another benchmark automatically.

input_access.message: The selected result is unavailable or is not an ordinary file.
input_access.next_action: Choose the preserved results.json explicitly. For a cached report use preview by submission ID; refusing upload does not require the original file.

parameters.message: Required historical test parameters are missing.
parameters.next_action: Use an original result containing the named parameters, or keep the local report. Do not fill historical values from the current machine or rerun a benchmark without permission.

consent.message: This exact report does not have current explicit publication consent.
consent.next_action: Run preview for this submission ID, show the X link and privacy notice, and ask for the current decision. Only after explicit agreement call consent with --decision publish and the returned --notice-version.

integrity.message: The frozen report no longer matches its recorded checksum; further upload has stopped.
integrity.next_action: Preserve the cache and original result. If a previous request may have reached the service, check its receipt first. Prepare a new snapshot and obtain fresh consent; do not rewrite the checksum.

not_found.message: That local report was not found.
not_found.next_action: Use list to select an existing submission ID or ask the user for a preserved result; do not scan the disk.

state.message: Private local sharing state could not be used safely.
state.next_action: Keep existing files. Check ownership, space and concurrent operations; after an existing operation finishes, retry once and use list to reconcile. Choose a new private --state-dir if needed; never overwrite an unrelated database.

version.message: This snapshot or cache version is unsupported.
version.next_action: Use a compatible DriveSpeed version or prepare again from the retained original result and obtain fresh consent. Do not edit version labels or checksums.

conflict.message: A frozen snapshot with that ID already exists.
conflict.next_action: Use preview for the existing ID. To publish different content, prepare a new snapshot and obtain a new explicit decision; do not overwrite it.

language.message: The requested UI language or message file is not supported.
language.next_action: Use --ui-language en, zh or ar, or supply --ui-messages with a complete message template from assets/community/locales/en.json.

authorization_pending: Open the verification URL, match the code and confirm this report. The command waits up to 10 minutes. A confirmation page is not an acceptance receipt.

credentials.message: The private management credential is missing or belongs to a different service.
credentials.next_action: Preserve local state. Do not generate a replacement token for this ID; choose the original state directory and service.

busy.message: Another sharing operation owns this report.
busy.next_action: Wait for that operation to finish, then retry by the same submission ID. Do not remove its lock file.

network.message: The community service response is unavailable or could not be verified.
network.next_action: Keep the same report ID and state. Check its receipt before retrying; respect Retry-After and never bypass TLS or change measurements.

http.message: The community service rejected this operation.
http.next_action: Check the stable error code and preserved report. Use receipt before another submission; if restricted, contact X @slime5409 to request an unlock.

authorization.message: Authorization did not complete for this report.
authorization.next_action: Keep the local report. A refusal is not permission to upload; obtain a fresh explicit decision before starting another authorization flow.

samples.message: No usable reference snapshot is available.
samples.next_action: Keep your local report. If the user explicitly wants a fresh query, use receipt with --refresh-similar; do not invent samples or rerun tests automatically.
